title: fix(service-settings): the deployment notice no longer reports an unset mail transport

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DA5DQSCLsmvd1RyYUzvWijL)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:服务端的部署提示(管理员在首页和系统概览看到的那条)不再产出「未配置邮件服务」这一项;提示的指纹也不再包含它。
- **为什么改**:按您在 #32643 的裁决「环境的新手清单中要求设置邮箱。我觉得这个不应该是必须的设置」,邮件是可选设置。控制台那半边(PR #32797)已不再显示这一项,但服务端仍在下发,指纹里仍带着它,于是管理员隐藏提示后,只要后来配置了邮件,指纹一变,提示就又冒出来。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只删了一个提示项和它的数据来源,没有改发送邮件的任何流程。升级后一次性影响:之前隐藏过、且指纹里含邮件项的提示会再显示一次(只剩其余项),再隐藏一次即可。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:① `packages/services/service-settings/src/deployment-notice.ts`(删掉的分支和新加的「Mail is not a finding」说明);② `deployment-notice.routes.test.ts` 新的「mail is not a finding」用例;③ `settings-service-plugin.ts` 删掉的邮件来源。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/deployment-notice.routes.test.ts`,预期 20 个用例全绿,没有任何一项名为 `email_not_configured`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。
- **席位意见**:同意撤掉这条提示。服务端已无任何「需要发邮件却发不出」的信号可读，按卡上的约定不凭空造新信号;控制台残留的说明文字和 11 个语言包里不再被引用的文案键，对用户无可见影响，记在 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

The maintainer ruled on #32643 that mail is an optional setting, and triage (6819624775, 6834174169) and the coordinator (6819876581, item 3) narrowed what the deployment notice may say about it: only that something needs mail and cannot send it. PR #32797 stopped the Console drawing `email_not_configured`, but `readDeploymentNotice` still served it whenever `IEmailService.isConfigured()` did not answer `true`, and the fingerprint a hide acknowledges still named it, so configuring mail changed the fingerprint and re-showed a notice the administrator had hidden.

Of the card's two routes this takes **retire**. No runtime produces a "needs mail and cannot send" signal (measured below), and the card's rule is that a new server signal is named, not guessed.

1. `packages/services/service-settings/src/deployment-notice.ts`: the `email_not_configured` branch, the `DeploymentFindingId` member and the `DeploymentNoticeSources.emailDeliveryLive` source are removed. The header's finding list drops the bullet and gains a short "Mail is not a finding" section that states the rule, so the next author does not re-add it. `DeploymentFindingId` and `DeploymentNoticeSources` are not exported from the package entry (`src/index.ts`; `exports` is `.` only), so no published type changes.
2. `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service-plugin.ts`: the `emailDeliveryLive` reader handed to the door, and the now-unused `IEmailService` type import, are removed.
3. `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`: the notice paragraph no longer promises a mail line and says mail is not one of the findings.
4. `.changeset/32798-deployment-notice-mail-retired.md`: `@objectstack/service-settings` patch, with the one-time effect of the upgrade on a hide whose fingerprint named the finding.

## Tests

- `deployment-notice.routes.test.ts`: the old "two lower-severity lines" case becomes "local file storage is the one lower-severity line" (with its fingerprint). New negative pin "mail is not a finding": a production deployment with no mail fact states nothing (`{ production: true, findings: [], fingerprint: '' }`), and beside the three high findings plus local storage the fingerprint names exactly those four.
- `packages/cli/test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts` (the end-to-end pin on a real `os start`): the default boot's low lines are `['file_storage_local']`, and the served fingerprint is the four non-mail ids. The claim's file surface names this file (re-posted claim 6836772853).

## Acceptance notes

- **No existing "needs mail and cannot send" producer.** `git grep` at `c04aa295` for `sendsMail`, `requiresEmail`, `needsMail`, `mail_required`, `email_required`, `mailRequired`, `needs_mail`, `undeliverable` found no runtime signal a notice could read. The one near-miss is a boot-time log in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` (a local variable named `requiresEmail`): when email verification is required and no email service is registered, the auth plugin logs an `error` once at boot. It is a log line, keyed on a missing service (not on an unset transport), and nothing stores or serves it. The flows that send mail already read the transport themselves: invitations answer `link_only`, the forgot-password page reads `features.emailDelivery` (both from `AuthManager.isEmailDeliveryLive()`).
- **Console reader still naming the id (no `ui/**` in this PR).** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/deployment-notice/deploymentNotice.ts` (header prose says the server still serves `email_not_configured`, and its fingerprint still names it) and `__tests__/DeploymentNotice.test.tsx` (fixtures and a negative pin that feed the id). Both stay correct against this server: the Console drops unknown ids and sends back the served fingerprint. The header sentence is now stale, and the `deploymentNotice.finding.emailNotConfigured` key in all 11 packs of `ui/packages/i18n` is unreferenced. Left for a ui follow-up, as the card says.
- **Upgrade effect.** A hide is keyed by fingerprint in the administrator's browser. A hide recorded against a fingerprint that named `email_not_configured` no longer matches, so that notice shows once more on its remaining findings. The changeset says so.

## Verification

Final head `ebe4121a37` (`origin/main` `9891065a04` merged once, before opening; the merge brought `packages/spec` changes and nothing in `service-settings` or `cli`). Implementation commit `eb58189f`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` at `ebe4121a37`: `Test Files 75 passed (75)`, `Tests 1464 passed (1464)`. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts` (after building `@objectstack/cli...` at `eb58189f`): `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 101 commands; all 101 exit 0. 83 ran at `eb58189f` (same diff, pre-merge). After the merge, a whole-tree `turbo run build --concurrency=2` (exit 0), then 18 re-ran at `ebe4121a37`: the two that had exited 3 for a missing build (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`), every `@objectstack/spec` family (spec moved in the merge), and the changeset, citation, doc-authoring, dts-closure, test-source-alias and settings-bind-window families. `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: exit 0, "101 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm lint` at `eb58189f`: exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablation: the mail finding put back</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/services/service-settings/src/deployment-notice.ts --anchor "  return { production, findings, fingerprint" --replacement` (an unconditional `findings.push({ id: 'email_not_configured', severity: 'low' })` before the return) `-- pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/deployment-notice.routes.test.ts`. Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `f4bd8904` to `8cf2b7c9`). `Tests 12 failed | 8 passed (20)`, the new pin among them:

```text
× mail is not a finding: a deployment with no email service states nothing about it
AssertionError: expected { production: true, …(2) } to deeply equal { Object (production, findings, ...) }
× local file storage is the one lower-severity line
AssertionError: expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal [ { id: 'file_storage_local', …(1) } ]
```

Restored: blob after restore `f4bd8904` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `src/` directly (no dist leg). The first two attempts were no-ops refused by the tool (the anchor text survived inside the replacement); nothing ran on them.

</details>
